top_stories.title: Strategy resumes Bitcoin buying, expanding its lead as top corporate holder
points: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) bought 4,603 BTC for $369.7M ($80,318/BTC average) after a two-month pause, financed via at-the-market stock sales.
Total holdings now 845,050 BTC (~$66.1B at current prices), over 4% of Bitcoin's 21M coin supply cap, with a $75,412/BTC average cost basis and ~$2.34B in unrealized gains.
MSTR stock is down 63% from its 2025 peak despite a 6.3% weekly gain; CEO Michael Saylor's 'We're Back' social post preceded the announcement, as it has before prior purchases.
Bitcoin fell to $76,877 after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's rate-hike comments, well below the October 2025 peak near $126,000.
Strive Asset Group separately became the fifth-largest corporate Bitcoin holder after a major acquisition.

unique_angles.point: Strategy simultaneously repurchased STRC preferred shares and paid dividends while making the new BTC purchase.
Frames the Strive acquisition as evidence institutional ownership of Bitcoin is consolidating among major corporations, treating it as a long-term treasury asset rather than a speculative holding.

items.title: Poseidon2b hash function withstands algebraic attack, reinforcing Ethereum cryptography
points: A researcher published a point-by-point defense of the Poseidon2b hash function against the 'Skipping Class' algebraic attack proposed for use in Ethereum.

The attack targets wider state configurations (t=12–24) using a tensor MDS construction (a mathematical matrix structure), but production Poseidon2b uses t=4 with a full external MDS layer, placing it outside the attack's scope.

Best published cryptanalysis of production parameters (GF(2^128) field, x^7 S-box polynomial, 8 external/58 internal rounds) estimates attack complexity at ~2^410 operations, exceeding the 128-bit security target by 282 orders of magnitude.
The researcher released pinned source code and executable audits to invite targeted cryptanalysis of the exact configuration used in practice.

items.title: Coinbase launches tokenized US equities on Base via new B20 standard
points: Coinbase launched four tokenized stock tokens (NVDAc, METAc, AAPLc, GOOGLc) on the Base blockchain for non-US users, built on the new B20 standard for compliant onchain asset issuance.

B20's multiplier system updates a single onchain value to handle corporate actions like stock splits or dividends, avoiding disruption to AMM (automated market maker—a decentralized exchange mechanism) pool reserves.
A Shared Policy Registry propagates compliance updates like sanctions blocklists across all assets referencing it, letting administrators move tokens from flagged addresses with recorded memos.
The launch generated $10.8M in 24-hour trading volume and $3.06M in DEX liquidity across ~50 protocols; the broader tokenized public equities sector now totals $2.48B, led by Ondo at $872.7M.

items.title: ICE partners with tZERO on tokenized securities transfer program
points: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) partnered with tZERO on a digital transfer agent program for tokenized securities.
The deal licenses a 103-patent blockchain IP portfolio to support compliant onchain asset transfers.

items.title: Trump-linked crypto ventures leave investors billions underwater in 2025
points: Investors lost a minimum of $4.7B across Trump-linked crypto ventures in 2025, while Trump himself earned $1.4B from the same projects.
The TRUMP memecoin (a cryptocurrency token typically created for speculation or humor rather than utility) accounts for $3.2B of the total investor losses.
